items.headline: Bahrain me Iran ka US base par hamla
items.detail: IRGC ne daava kiya uske chhah drone ne al-Riffa base par US radar ko nishana banaya; Bahrain ne kaha hawai suraksha ne hamla roka, koi nuksan nahi — teen din me doosra hamla.
items.exam_angle: West Asia tanav, Bahrain, US Fifth Fleet — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zelensky: Donbas ke badle NATO sadasyata?
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha Abu Dhabi baatchit me America ne poocha — Donbas chhodne par Ukraine ko NATO milega? Kyiv ne kaha zameen nahi dega, par suraksha guarantee mile to janmat sangrah hoga.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, NATO vistar, Donbas — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Jordan: church hamle me teen ko maut
items.detail: Karak me 23 October ko Greek Orthodox church me antim sanskar par hamla kar 9 logon ko maarne wale teenon ko State Security Court ne phansi ki saza sunayi — faisla automatic review ke liye jayega.
items.exam_angle: Jordan, aatankwad kanoon, dharmik alpsankhyak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Nau deshon ne AI supply chain samjhauta kiya
items.detail: America aur aath sahyogi deshon ne San Francisco Declaration par hastakshar kiye — AI takneek, chip aur critical minerals ki supply chain ko China se bachane ke liye sanyukt suchi banegi.
items.exam_angle: Pax Silica, AI supply chain, critical minerals — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: ASEAN ne Myanmar neta par pratibandh badhaya
items.detail: Manila shikhar me netaon ne kaha Myanmar 2021 ki paanch-sutriya shanti yojana par amal me nakam raha — uske neta aur videsh mantri shikhar baithakon me shamil nahi ho sakenge.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, Myanmar sankat, paanch-sutriya sahmati — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: China ne Trump-Xi-Putin baithak ki pushti ki
items.detail: 19 November ko Shenzhen me APEC ke kinare pehli baar teenon neta milenge — parmanu hathiyar aur Iran par charcha hogi, Ukraine agenda se bahar.
items.exam_angle: APEC Shenzhen, trilateral shikhar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapoorn

items.headline: Chaar deshon ne Gaza me turant madad mangi
items.detail: Australia, Britain, Canada aur Italy ne Israel se kaha — baadh ke baad Gaza me 1,50,000 tent seema par ruke hain, turant aur bina rok-tok madad pahunche.
items.exam_angle: Gaza manaviya sankat, antarrashtriya kanoon — UPSC ke liye mahatvapoorn

items.headline: Iran: US hamle ka intezar nahi karenge
items.detail: Up videsh mantri Kazem Gharibabadi ne kaha Tehran baatchit, nakabandi ya yuddh — teenon ke liye taiyar hai; Hormuz kholne ki 48 ghante wali yojana abhi bhi mez par hai.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanav, Hormuz jaladmaru — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Japan ki economy July-September me siki
items.detail: Cabinet Office ke aankdon me GDP saalana 0.1% gira — chaar timahi me pehli giravat; niji khapat 0.3% kam hui, Bank of Japan ke byaj faisle par asar padega.
items.exam_angle: Japan GDP, Bank of Japan byaj dar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houthi ne Riyadh par missile daage
items.detail: Houthi ne daava kiya usne Riyadh ke King Khalid airport aur vitt kendra par do ballistic missile daage; Saudi gathbandhan ne kaha dono rok liye gaye, nuksan ki swatantra pushti nahi.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Saudi-Houthi takraar, Khadi suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Estonia 1 December se Russia seema band karega
items.detail: Videsh mantri Margus Tsahkna ne kaha drone nirmata Threod Systems par GRU ke aadesh par hue aagjani ke prayas ke baad teenon seema chaukiyan — Narva, Luhamaa, Koidula — 1 December se band hongi; avadhi tay nahi.
items.exam_angle: Estonia-Russia, NATO, seema suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: ASEAN-China samudra code ki deadline chooki
items.detail: Philippines ke videsh mantri ne kaha masaude ka lagbhag 80% tay hua, par kanuni roop aur seema par matbhed bane hue; baatchit 2027 me Singapore ki adhyakshata me jaari rahegi.
items.exam_angle: Dakshin Cheen Sagar, ASEAN, samudri kanoon — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Italy ne Meta par €805 million jurmana lagaya
items.detail: Facebook app ne bina sahmati ke lagbhag 2 crore Italian Android users ki photo gallery dekhi — niyamak ne 60 din me alag sahmati ka niyam banane ko kaha, Meta appeal karega.
items.exam_angle: Data suraksha, GDPR/ePrivacy, big tech niyaman — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hasina ki wapsi par Gopalganj me hinsa
items.detail: Sheikh Hasina ke samarthakon ne Gopalganj me police ki gaadi jalayi aur chauki todi — Hasina ne December me Bangladesh lautne ka irada jataya hai, jabki unhe maut ki saza sunayi gayi hai.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh, Sheikh Hasina, pratyarpan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Teesra US carrier Middle East pahuncha
items.detail: USS Theodore Roosevelt CENTCOM kshetra me dakhil hua — ab Iran nakabandi me teen US carrier; Tehran ne pehle hamle ki chetavni di.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanav, Hormuz nakabandi — UPSC ke liye mahatvapoorn

items.headline: Mexico ke 'drug godfather' Gallardo ka nidhan
items.detail: Guadalajara cartel ke sansthapak Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo (80) ka aspatal me nidhan — 1989 se jail me the, 1985 me DEA agent ki hatya ke doshi; kai angon ne kaam karna band kar diya.
items.exam_angle: Mexico drug yuddh, DEA, antarrashtriya apraadh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Yemen: sarkari fauj Bab el-Mandeb se peeche hati
items.detail: Saudi samarthit Southern Armed Forces ne Dhubab Airport aur Bab el-Mandeb se sainikon ko Aden ki raksha ke liye wapas bulaya — chhah hafte ka jawabi hamla khatm, Houthi ab laal sagar ke dakshini dwar par mazboot.
items.exam_angle: Bab el-Mandeb, Yemen grih yuddh, Houthi — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Prince Harry achanak Ukraine pahunche
items.detail: Prince Harry ne Lviv me ghayal sainikon aur chikitsakon se milkar kaha 'tum yuddh jeetoge' — 2022 se chaarvi yatra; Invictus Games ke liye chune jaane wale khiladiyon se bhi mile.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Invictus Games — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Houthi ne 600 bandiyon ko riha kiya
items.detail: Red Cross ne pushti ki: Houthi ne Sanaa me sarkari paksh ke 600 kaidiyon ko ekpakshiya riha kiya — Yemen yuddh ki sabse badi aisi rihai; Aden ke paas ladai tez hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Red Cross, Bab el-Mandeb — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine ne Nizhnekamsk par drone hamla kiya
items.detail: Ukraine ne zimmedari lete hue kaha uske drones ne Tatarstan ke Nizhnekamskneftekhim petrochemical complex aur TAIF-NK refinery ko nishana banaya, dono jagah aag lagi; mayor ne lambe hamle ki pushti ki.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, urja avasanrachna par hamle — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Israel ne Hamas ke Rafah commander ko mara
items.detail: IDF ne kaha Samir Abu Younis Khan Younis me raat ke hamle me mara gaya; Hamas ne maut ki pushti ki aur use 7 October hamle ka yojnakar bataya — yuddhviram ke bawjood tanav badha.
items.exam_angle: Gaza yuddhviram, Hamas, Israel — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: SpaceX ne Starship ko pehli baar pakda
items.detail: Flight 15 ki Ship 42 22 ghante kaksha me bitakar Starbase lautkar Mechazilla ki baanhon me phansi — pehli baar koi Starship pakda gaya; booster kharab hokar samudra me gir gaya.
items.exam_angle: Punh-prayog yogya rocket, antariksh takneek — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump, Xi, Putin 19 November ko milenge
items.detail: Teeno parmanu shaktiyon ke neta pehli baar Shenzhen me APEC shikhar ke kinare milenge; parmanu hathiyar katauti aur Iran par charcha hogi, Ukraine agenda me nahi.
items.exam_angle: APEC, parmanu hathiyar niyantran, New START ki samapti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Australia-Philippines ne raksha samjhauta kiya
items.detail: Manila me 49th ASEAN Summit ke kinare dono deshon ne Defence Cooperation Arrangement par hastakshar kiye — sanyukt sainya abhyas aur aapda madad me sahyog aasan hoga, Dakshin Cheen Sagar me bhi.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, Australia-Philippines DCA, Dakshin Cheen Sagar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America me router kharabi se udanein thapi
items.detail: Shukravar ko FAA ne lagbhag paanch ghante ke liye desh bhar ki udanein roki — router ki gadbadi se 9,000 se zyada flights radd hui, 15 lakh yatri fase; Ravivar tak bhi hazaron flights prabhavit rahi.
items.exam_angle: FAA, America ki hawai suraksha, purani takneek — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Cape Verde me Neves dobara rashtrapati bane
items.detail: Ravivar ke chunav me José Maria Neves ko 63.8% vote mile — pehli mahila ummidwar Joana Rosa ko 31.6%; aadhikarik natije is hafte aayenge, matdan ek-tihai se kam raha.
items.exam_angle: Cape Verde, Africa ki sthir loktantra, rashtrapati chunav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America-China: $30 arab tariff katauti par charcha
items.detail: Dono deshon ki pehli Trade Council baithak me $30 arab-$30 arab ki parasparik tariff katauti par baat hui, par koi antim samjhauta nahi — Trump-Xi mulakat se pehle krishi vyapar par bhi charcha hui.
items.exam_angle: America-China vyapar, APEC, tariff — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: France me paanchve hafte bhi lakhon sadkon par
items.detail: Shanivar ko France bhar me lagbhag 1,06,000 log sadkon par utre — mehngai, shiksha aur police ko zyada suraksha dene wale prastav ke khilaf paanchva lagatar pradarshan; sanghon ne Mangalvar ko hadtal bulayi.
items.exam_angle: France, Yellow Vest, Macron — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Canary Islands: do din me 2,200 pravasi aaye
items.detail: Spain ke Canary Islands me shukravar-shanivar ko lagbhag 2,200 pravasi naav se pahunche — zyadatar chhote El Hierro dweep par; Spain ne 11 November ko pravasan aapatkal ghoshit kiya tha.
items.exam_angle: Spain, pravasan sankat, Atlantic route — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Hormuz me do aur tanker khano se takraye
items.detail: IRGC ka dawa hai Somvar ko bhi do tanker Hormuz me khano se takrakar jal gaye, ek 20 lakh barrel tel wala supertanker doob gaya — Ravivar se kul chhe tanker ka dawa, swatantra pushti nahi; UKMTO ne ek hamle ki pushti ki, koi hatahat nahi.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, tel vyapar, America-Iran tanav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Saudi ne do ko phansi, ek nabalig tha
items.detail: Saudi ne 14 November ko Fadel al-Safwani aur Jawad Qureiris ko aatankwad ke aarop me phansi di — rights group Reprieve ke mutabik Qureiris aarop wale virodh ke samay 14 saal ka tha; August 2025 se aise paanch logo ko phansi ho chuki hai.
items.exam_angle: Saudi Arabia, mrityudand, manavadhikar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine vaarta me ab Europe bhi shamil hoga
items.detail: America ke doot Jared Kushner ne kaha agle daur ki Russia-Ukraine vaarta me Europe ke pratinidhi bhi honge — suraksha guarantee aur Donbas par charcha jaari, Abu Dhabi vaarta me kaidi adla-badli par sehmati bani thi.
items.exam_angle: Ukraine-Russia vaarta, NATO, suraksha guarantee — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Jordan: church hamle ke teen ko phansi
items.detail: Karak me 23 October ko Greek Orthodox church me antim sanskar par hamla kar 9 logon ko maarne wale teenon ko State Security Court ne phansi ki saza sunayi — faisla automatic review ke liye jayega. (Corrected: headline sudhari gayi — hamle me 9 log mare the; teen hamlaavaron ko phansi mili.)
items.exam_angle: Jordan, aatankwad kanoon, dharmik alpsankhyak — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Yemen se sarkari fauj peeche hati
items.detail: Bab el-Mandeb ke paas se sarkari fauj Aden ki taraf peeche hati, Houthi ne 600 kaidi riha kiye.
items.exam_angle: Bab el-Mandeb — Lal Sagar ka aham samudri rasta, Bharat ke vyapar ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Prince Harry Ukraine me ghayal sainikon se mile
items.detail: Prince Harry ne Lviv me ghayal sainikon se mulakat ki aur kaha Ukraine yuddh jeetega, Invictus Games ka wada kiya.

items.headline: Vulcan rocket fail, 40 satellite nasht
items.detail: ULA ka Vulcan rocket udaan ke 10 minute baad fail hua, Amazon Leo ke 40 satellite nasht ho gaye.
items.exam_angle: Amazon Leo vs Starlink — satellite internet ki daud.

items.headline: Prague me lakhon ne media ke liye march kiya
items.detail: Czech sarkar ke public media funding badalne ke plan ke khilaf Prague me lakhon log sadkon par utre.
items.exam_angle: Public media ki swatantrata — loktantra ke liye aham sawal.

items.headline: EU: pehle yuddhviram, phir vaarta
items.detail: EU videsh mantri Kaja Kallas ne kaha Russia se suraksha par baat tabhi hogi jab Ukraine me yuddhviram ho aur Moscow riyayat de — Russia ki maangein 'betuki' batayi; naye pratibandh package par bhi kaam jaari.
items.exam_angle: EU, Ukraine shanti vaarta, pratibandh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Zelensky: Starshield rok hatao
items.detail: Zelensky ne kaha Starshield ki 161 km/h gati seema se Ukraine ke interceptor drone Shahed drone ko pakad nahi pa rahe — sardiyon se pehle urja dhanche ki suraksha khatre me; SpaceX ne badlav se inkar kiya.
items.exam_angle: Starshield, upgrah sanchar, drone yuddh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Phuket me aag, 11 ki maut
items.detail: Phuket ke Patong me subah ek shophouse me aag lagi — 11 log mare, 16 ghayal; do ghante me aag kabu me aayi, karan ki jaanch jaari hai.
items.exam_angle: Thailand, paryatan suraksha, aag niyaman — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: South Africa: do hamlo me 17 mare
items.detail: Pretoria ke paas ek jhopdi me 9 aur Pietermaritzburg ke paas ek gaadi me 8 log mare gaye — Ravivar raat ke hamle, karan abhi agyaat, koi giraftari nahi.
items.exam_angle: South Africa, hinsak apradh, banduk hinsa — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Teesra US aircraft carrier Middle East pahuncha
items.detail: USS Theodore Roosevelt Ravivar ko CENTCOM kshetra me pahuncha — ab kshetra me teen US carrier strike group; Pentagon ne abhi aupcharik pushti nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran tanav, Hormuz, nausena tainati — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ne IAEA nirikshan se inkar kiya
items.detail: Up-videsh mantri Gharibabadi ne kaha Iran apne kshatigrast parmanu sthalon — Natanz, Fordow, Isfahan — par IAEA nirikshan tab tak nahi dega jab tak yuddh sthayi roop se khatm na ho aur America shartein na mane.
items.exam_angle: IAEA, Iran parmanu karyakram, West Asia — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mexico drug 'Godfather' Gallardo ki maut, 80
items.detail: Guadalajara cartel ke sansthapak Miguel Angel Felix Gallardo ka Ravivar ko aspatal me nidhan — 1989 se jail me the, 1985 me US DEA agent ki hatya ke doshi.
items.exam_angle: Mexico, drug cartel, DEA — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Ukraine ka Russia par sabse bada drone hamla
items.detail: Raat bhar ke hamle me Russia ne 1,336 drone giraye ka dawa kiya — 29 October ka 1,254 wala record toota; Crimea ko jodne wala Kerch pull bhi nishana bana, Kremlin ne nuksan halka bataya.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, drone yuddh, Kerch pull — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kango Ebola: 11,376 case, 5,568 maut
items.detail: Chhah mahine me Kango ka Ebola prakop kabu se bahar — 14 November tak 11,376 case aur 5,568 maut; WHO ne kaha hafte me 400-500 naye case aa rahe hain, hinsa aur bharose ki kami roktham me badha.
items.exam_angle: Ebola, WHO, Kango — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Estonia 1 December se Russia border band karega
items.detail: Drone maker Threod Systems par GRU ke aadesh se aag lagane ki koshish ke baad Estonia ne 1 December se Russia se lagte teeno border crossing band karne ka elan kiya; 8 log giraftar, Kremlin ne aarop kharij kiya.
items.exam_angle: Estonia, NATO, Russia, GRU, hybrid warfare — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Italy ne Meta par $887 million jurmana lagaya
items.detail: Italy ke data regulator Garante ne Meta par €805 million ($887 million) ka jurmana lagaya — Facebook Android app bina sahmati ke lagbhag 2 crore users ki gallery ki photo-video khol raha tha; Meta appeal karega.
items.exam_angle: Data protection, ePrivacy, Big Tech regulation — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: SpaceX ne pehli baar Starship upper stage pakda
items.detail: 22.5 ghante ki udan aur 14 chakkar ke baad Starship ka upper stage pehli baar launch tower ki 'chopsticks' me pakda gaya; Super Heavy booster pakda nahi ja saka aur samudra me gira.
items.exam_angle: SpaceX, Starship, reusable rocket — UPSC science-tech ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Gaza me Hamas ke Rafah commander mare gaye
items.detail: Israel ke hamle me Hamas ke Rafah Brigade commander Samir Abu Younis mare gaye — Hamas aur IDF dono ne pushti ki; yuddhviram ke bawjood Gaza me hamle jaari hain.
items.exam_angle: Israel-Hamas, Gaza yuddhviram — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Germany ne Russia ki nayi suraksha yojana thukrai
items.detail: Videsh Mantri Wadephul ne Brussels me kaha — Europe ko nayi suraksha vyavastha nahi chahiye, maujooda samjhauton ka samman hi kaafi hai; France ne bhi Europe ki suraksha vyavastha bachane ki kasam khayi.
items.exam_angle: Germany, Russia, European security architecture, NATO — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
items.image_credit: Olaf Kosinsky, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 3.0 de)

items.headline: Houthi ne Saudi par hamle ka aarop lagaya
items.detail: Houthi ne kaha Saudi ke do hamlo me Yemen me ek bacche samet 3 log mare gaye; Riyadh ne abhi koi jawab nahi diya, July se 2022 ka yuddhviram toota hua hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen, Houthi, Saudi Arabia — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: EU Ukraine ko sardi me 500 generator dega
items.detail: EU Commissioner Lahbib ne kaha Russia sardi ko hathiyar bana raha hai; Ukraine ko 500 generator, Norway se 4 pul aur France se 200 bus milenge.
items.exam_angle: EU, Ukraine, rescEU, winter aid — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.
